We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Information and Computer Technology, Networking, IT Security from an accredited university.

title: Senior Product Analytics Engineer - Ads
description:
About Faire

Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town - we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.

We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

About this role

Ads is one of the fastest-growing and most strategically important parts of Faire's business, and the Ads Data team - now three years old - is entering a period of hypergrowth. As a product analytical engineer, you will own the end-to-end ads data foundation and models. You will partner closely with cross-functional teams in Product, Engineering, ML Applied Sciences, and Strategy & Analytics (S&A) to support product launches and roadmaps by designing and building data capabilities that inform and drive insights. You will lead the path in using AI to boost productivity and transform how analytical engineering operates-leveraging AI to streamline data pipeline development and operations, improve data consumption workflows, and automate routine analytical tasks. In this role, you'll see a direct link between your work, company growth, and user satisfaction. 

Join us and be part of a team that values data-driven innovation and excellence.

What you’ll do 

The ideal candidate will possess a perfect blend of analytics and data engineering expertise, along with strong skills in developing and supporting large-scale, high-performance data storage and processing systems. They should have a proven track record of collaborating with key stakeholders to execute on company-wide data initiatives. 

• Lead the design, implementmentation, and optimization of end-to-end and scalable data pipelines and models for a domain defining the architecture, feature requirements, roadmap.

• Collaborate with engineers, product managers, S&A, and ML applied scientists to translate business requirements into production-grade data systems and insights.

• Build and maintain data infrastructure, pipelines, and models that ensure data quality, consistency, and accessibility for analytical workflows.

• Redefine how we build, maintain, and scale data systems by embedding AI into our daily workflows.

• Mentor team members on best practices for scalable data engineering and quantitative problem-solving.

• Ensure and promote data quality standards for accurate and reliable insights.

• Embrace emerging technologies with enthusiasm.

Qualifications

• 4+ years experience in analytics & data engineering roles focused on data modeling, large-scale data processing, and tool development for analytics or data science use cases. Preferred experiences within Ads domain.

• Demonstrated communication and leadership skills, with a history of initiating and steering successful projects across multiple stakeholders.

• Production-level development experience in Python.

• Strong SQL skills with demonstrable competencies in designing well-architected data models and optimizing query performance.

• Deep experience and knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ETLs, big data technologies, and analytics platforms.

• Experience with Airflow, Docker, DBT or similar analytics workflow tools.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Math, Physics, or a related technical field. 

California: the pay range for this role is $ 196,000 to $ 269,500 per year.

This role will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

From Stablecoin payment infrastructure to fiat settlement rails, wallet services, and custom local Stablecoin issuance, Yellow Card provides the complete infrastructure businesses need to manage Stablecoins, payments, and operations across 50 emerging markets.

Yellow Card operates with a substantial global team spanning 24 countries. This workforce is characterized by its linguistic diversity, with collective speaking of over 25 languages, underscoring the company's extensive international reach.

As our Payroll Associate, you'll make sure people across our African markets get paid accurately and on time. Reporting to the Payroll Manager, you'll sit between HR and our external payroll providers, catching errors before they reach a payslip and keeping every cycle compliant with local legislation. It's detail-heavy work with a direct, immediate impact on every employee's paycheck.

What You'll Do

• Support end-to-end payroll processing across multiple African countries, from input validation through to disbursement under the supervision of the Payroll Manager.

• Review payroll inputs received from HR for completeness and accuracy, and chase down anything missing or inconsistent before cut-off.

• Process approved payroll changes - new hires, terminations, salary adjustments, bonuses, commissions, leave, and benefits.

• Coordinate submissions with external payroll providers, track processing timelines, and investigate discrepancies before approval.

• Prepare payroll journals and reconcile payroll-related balance sheet accounts.

• Generate recurring and ad hoc payroll reports, and support month-end and year-end reporting and audits.

• Respond to employee payroll queries professionally

• Stay current on payroll legislation, statutory deductions, and labour law across our African markets, and keep internal controls, policies, and process documentation compliant and audit-ready.

What You'll Bring (Must-Have)

• Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, or a related field.

• Hands-on experience in payroll using payroll software.

• 3+ years experience supporting payroll across multiple African countries, in a high-growth, multi-entity organization.

• Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

• High attention to detail and strong organizational skills, with the discretion to handle confidential payroll data with integrity.

• Experience working with outsourced payroll providers, including preparing payroll journals and reconciliations.

• Familiarity with BambooHR (or similar HRIS) and NetSuite (or similar ERP).

• Working knowledge of payroll tax, statutory deductions, and labour legislation across African jurisdictions.

What We Offer

• Compensation & Benefits: We offer competitive compensation and meaningful health coverage, and all full-time employees are participants in our stock option plan.

• Learning & Development: Access to resources, support, and autonomy to grow professionally.

• Remote-First Flexibility: We embrace a fully remote work environment.

• Mental Health Support Services: Your mental well-being matters to us.

• Global & Diverse Team: You will have the opportunity to work with talented professionals from 24+ countries across the world, in a multicultural and collaborative environment.

• Global Impact: You'll be part of a team shaping the future of global FinTech and stablecoin accessibility.

Ready to Join Us?

title: Head of Marketing, Langfuse
description:
ABOUT LANGFUSE

Langfuse is the open-source LLM engineering platform that helps teams build useful AI applications through tracing, evaluation, prompt management, datasets, and metrics. We are now part of ClickHouse. Like ClickHouse, Langfuse is open source, and we work in public: our product, docs, changelog, roadmap, and community discussions are visible to the developers and teams who use us. Langfuse is already one of the most widely adopted platforms in the category: trusted by 19 of the Fortune 50 and 63 of the Fortune 500, with 50M+ SDK installs per month, 6M+ Docker pulls, and 30k+ GitHub stars.

We are hiring a Head of Marketing for Langfuse.

This is a hands-on marketing leadership role for someone with deep experience in product marketing, developer marketing, and technical content. You will own how Langfuse shows up in the market, manage the Langfuse marketing team, and turn our current founder-led, product-led motion into a holistic marketing ecosystem.

The core of the role is still product marketing and developer trust: positioning, launches, category narrative, developer content, website, customer proof, lifecycle, funnel, sales enablement, and the way we explain Langfuse to technical users and technical buyers. At the same time, Langfuse now has access to ClickHouse's global go-to-market engine. You will be the person who makes those resources work for Langfuse without diluting the Langfuse voice.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

- Own Langfuse marketing strategy and execution globally, with product marketing and developer content as the center of gravity.

- Manage and develop the Langfuse marketing team, including Product Marketing Engineering, Developer Advocacy, and Product Marketing content and resources.

- Define the operating model for Langfuse marketing: what sits in the Langfuse pod, what runs through ClickHouse shared teams, who owns what, and how we measure whether it is working.

- Own the Langfuse category narrative: LLM observability, evals, prompt management, datasets, agent observability, self-hosting, and the broader LLM engineering workflow.

- Keep the developer motion strong: useful technical content, examples, cookbooks, docs-adjacent education, changelog, town halls, open-source communication, and high-trust product launches.

- Partner with ClickHouse demand generation and field marketing to make enterprise marketing systematic rather than ad hoc: webinars, workshops, regional events, conferences, paid campaigns, retargeting, and follow-up motions.

- Create the canonical Langfuse sales narrative and enablement system so ClickHouse AEs, SAs, field teams, and leadership can confidently explain Langfuse.

- Lead customer marketing and proof: case studies, technical stories, customer references, logo strategy, community stories, enterprise migration stories, and reusable sales narratives.

- Use data to run the function: unique visitors, signups, activation, revenue, product usage signals, campaign performance, attribution, event ROI, pipeline creation, pipeline acceleration, and qualitative user feedback.

WHAT YOU BRING ALONG:

- You have led product marketing, developer marketing, DevRel, growth, or demand gen marketing for a technical SaaS product.

- You have marketed to developers, infrastructure teams, AI teams, data teams, security teams, observability teams, or another highly technical audience.

- You are a strong product marketer at the core: positioning, narrative, launch strategy, competitive thinking, customer proof, sales enablement, and technical buyer messaging are natural territory for you.

- You write exceptionally well. You can make complex technical ideas clear without making them shallow.

- You are technical enough to use the product, understand the market, earn credibility

Who is a Billing Manager?

A Billing Managerin a medical company is responsible for monitoring and ensuring all financial operations related to a patient’s stay in the hospital, including:

• Entering patient information into the accounting system;

• Determining the patient’s insurance coverage details;

• Collecting financial information about the patient (bills, assets, cash flow, etc.);

• Tracking payments and ensuring timely reimbursements.

• Fluency in both written and spoken Еnglish

• Ability to check authorization status over the phone and online (checking the auth levels; number of days approved, last covered date, etc.)

• Working with Census (checking the information in the system before sending the claims to the insurance)

• Checking the claims over the phone and online

• Working on the case of the patient until the full payment is received (sending the claims for reprocessing in case it’s denied incorrectly, sending corrected claims or appeals)

• Preparing letters/bills to patients and discussing the balances with the patients over the phone

• Posting payments into the system

• Generating the reports/aging to make sure that all the payments were received

• Communication with clients and primary data entry to the application program

📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden
Voor een data-gedreven proof of concept zoeken we 2 profielen die meewerken aan de ontwikkeling van een overdraagbare oplossing voor de geautomatiseerde detectie en verklaring van trendwijzigingen in binnenvaarttrafieken.
De beschikbare data bevatten onder meer informatie over vervoersstromen, herkomst en bestemming, corridors, ladingen en lossingen, tonnages, doorvaarten en andere reiskenmerken. De opdracht onderzoekt in welke mate technologie relevante evoluties automatisch kan signaleren, mogelijke verklarende parameters kan identificeren en de sterkte en onzekerheid van verbanden transparant kan weergeven.
Het gaat nadrukkelijk om een ondersteunend analyse-instrument en niet om een autonoom beslissingssysteem. Inhoudelijke validatie door de eindorganisatie blijft noodzakelijk. De opdracht moet bovendien aantonen of deze aanpak technisch, organisatorisch en operationeel haalbaar is binnen de bestaande ICT-context.

• Een proof of concept ontwerpen, bouwen, testen, documenteren en overdraagbaar opleveren.

• Trendwijzigingen, afwijkingen en trendbreuken in trafiekdata automatisch detecteren en analyseren.

• Directe en indirecte verbanden onderzoeken tussen trafiekdata en interne of externe verklarende variabelen.

• Rapporteren op een transparante manier over bron, methode, sterkte van verbanden, onzekerheid, beperkingen en reproduceerbaarheid.

• Een werkend en testbaar prototype opleveren binnen de goedgekeurde projectomgeving.

• Rekening houden met functionaliteit, beveiliging, technische haalbaarheid, toegangsbeheer, dataclassificatie en integratiemogelijkheden.

• Zorgen voor volledige kennisoverdracht, inclusief broncode, configuratie en technische documentatie, zodat verdere uitbreiding en beheer mogelijk blijven.

• Complexe analyses helder toelichten aan stakeholders met uiteenlopende technische achtergronden.

📝 Jouw profiel

• Je hebt ruime ervaring met data-analyse en het analyseren van datastromen.

• Je hebt sterke kennis van tijdreeksanalyse, trenddetectie en change point detectie, bijvoorbeeld met tools zoals Darts, Sktime of PyTorch Forecasting.

• Je beheerst scriptingtalen zoals Python en/of R; kennis van Shell of Perl is een meerwaarde.

• Je hebt grondige kennis van SQL, databanken zoals Oracle en het optimaliseren of tunen van databases en queries.

• Je hebt ervaring met data modelling, bij voorkeur in een Databricks-omgeving.

• Je beschikt over kennis van LLM en RAG.

• Je hebt ervaring met Power BI voor dashboards, datavisualisatie en data-optimalisatie, en je kan noden van stakeholders vertalen naar passende Power BI-oplossingen.

• Je hebt kennis van gevorderde statistische technieken en concepten.

• Je bent sterk in rapportering en kan bevindingen gestructureerd en begrijpelijk presenteren.

• Ervaring met projecten binnen de overheid is een plus.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description: UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable. Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia. UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems. About the Role We're hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to make our systems work reliably in real-world deployed environments, not just in controlled engineering settings. This role closes the gap between Engineering, Product, Operations, Customer Success, and the customer - owning technical execution in the field, catching issues early, and turning field reality into clear engineering action. You'll need to be comfortable operating across domains rather than as a single-discipline specialist: reasoning practically across software, electronics, hardware, comms, and operations, and diagnosing issues with whatever time, tools, and backup are actually available onsite. Expect regular travel and field time, hands-on work outside a narrow job description, and close collaboration with Engineering, Product, Operations, and Customer Success. Responsibilities Own technical execution in the field - deploying, troubleshooting, and supporting systems in real-world environments outside the lab. Diagnose and resolve issues across domains without needing everything translate

title: Product Management Director, Subsystems
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

As Director of Product Management for Subsystems, you will lead the strategic vision and portfolio execution for the hardware and networking infrastructure powering Everpure’s FlashArray and FlashBlade platforms. Operating as an influential player-coach, you will build and empower a team of Subsystem PMs while partnering directly with VP leadership, Engineering, and Supply Chain to set operational objectives and budgets. Your leadership directly impacts overall enterprise success by transforming complex compute , chassis, and fabric innovations into resilient, market-leading storage architectures.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

•
Build and Direct High-Performing Teams : Recruit, mentor, and lead a functional organization of Subsystem PMs, establishing clear team goals, operational work plans, and performance benchmarks to drive portfolio execution.

•
Define Multi-Year Subsystem Strategy : Own the long-term product definition, qualification criteria, and lifecycle roadmap for hardware ( compute , chassis, interconnect) and networking fabrics (Ethernet, Fibre Channel, NVMe-oF) across FlashArray and FlashBlade lines.

•
Establish Architectural Guardrails : Drive strategic alignment across Engineering, Manufacturing, and Field teams by defining reference architectures that ensure consistent performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency across the portfolio.

•
Manage Executive & Field Collaborations : Serve as the authoritative technical partner in C-level roadmap reviews, high-stakes customer escalations, and competitive proof-of-concept engagements where deep hardware fluency drives enterprise revenue growth.

•
Govern Portfolio TCO and Delivery : Direct functional budget priorities, unit economics, and supply chain trade-offs to optimize product margins and accelerate market delivery across all platform subsystems.

WHAT YOU BRING

•
People Leadership & Organizational Development : Demonstrated capability recruiting, managing, and empowering technical product management or systems engineering teams, with expertise establishing operational procedures, resource allocation, and talent development.

•
Hardware & Networking Architecture Expertise : Deep technical command of enterprise storage hardware, server compute platforms, backend interconnects, and high-speed networking protocols (Ethernet, Fibre Channel, NVMe-oF).

•
Strategic & Financial Acumen : Advanced skill evaluating complex business variables, analyzing cost of goods sold (COGS), balancing supply chain constraints, and making final operational decisions to safeguard portfolio margin and schedule goals.

•
Executive Presence & Technical Influence : Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, with proven ability to influence senior executive decisions, lead cross-functional architecture reviews, and build trust with major enterprise clients.

•
Location : We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara, CA office in compliance with Everpure’s policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

 #LI-ONSITE
 

Salary ranges are determined based on role, level and location. For positions open to candidates in multiple geographical locations, the base salary range is reflective of the labor market across the applicable locations. 

This role may be eligible for incentive pay and/or equity.

title: Process & Automation Specialist
description:
Job Title: Process & Automation Specialist
Location: Remote
Role Type: Full-Time
Who Are We?
At Reef, we connect elite talent with high-growth companies building world-class teams.
We work exclusively with the top 3% of candidates and match them with established companies across Australia, New Zealand, the US, and UK that are serious about investing in their people and operational infrastructure.
We support your integration into these companies by providing additional training, admin/HR support, and access to our growing community of high-performing professionals.
About the Company
Our client is a growing Australian business focused on improving operational efficiency through systems, process optimisation, and automation.
As the business scales, they are investing in reducing manual workflows, improving cross-functional efficiency, and implementing automation across sales, fulfilment, and internal operations to support long-term growth.
With fragmented systems and repetitive processes creating operational bottlenecks, the company is now seeking a specialist who can identify inefficiencies, build scalable automation solutions, and improve how the business runs.
About the Role
We’re seeking an experienced Process & Automation Specialist to analyse existing workflows, identify opportunities for improvement, and design and implement automation systems that reduce manual work and improve efficiency.
You’ll act as both a consultant and builder - mapping business processes, diagnosing inefficiencies, and implementing practical automation solutions using tools such as N8N, Zapier, Make.com , APIs, and AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude .
The role will span core functions including sales workflows, fulfilment processes, and internal operations , with a focus on reducing repetitive tasks, improving system reliability, and creating scalable processes that support growth.
This is a hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys solving operational problems, building systems, and creating measurable impact through automation.
Requirements
Excellent spoken and written English
Previous experience in process improvement, operations, automation, or systems implementation
Strong experience using tools such as N8N, Zapier, Make.com, APIs, or similar automation platforms
Experience working with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI-powered workflow tools
Ability to analyse business workflows, identify inefficiencies, and translate them into automation solutions
Strong systems thinking and problem-solving ability
Experience documenting workflows, SOPs, and process maps
Comfortable integrating systems across CRMs, communication tools, and operational platforms
High attention to detail and ability to test and maintain reliable automations
Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Fast and reliable internet connection; your own laptop or desktop suitable for the role; a quiet working environment
Benefits
Competitive salary based on experience
Performance-based bonus structure tied to automation outcomes and efficiency improvements
Opportunity to play a key role in building scalable systems and operational infrastructure
Growth potential as the company expands its automation capabilities
Access to other job opportunities through REEF

title: Retention Lead
description:
Acerca del Grupo QuintoAndar

Somos el Grupo QuintoAndar, el ecosistema inmobiliario más grande de América Latina . Guiados por el propósito de ayudar a las personas a amar el lugar donde viven , creamos tecnología y soluciones que simplifican toda la experiencia de la vivienda, desde el alquiler hasta la compra y venta.

Estamos presentes en 6 países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Perú, Ecuador y Panamá) y contamos con un hub de tecnología en Portugal , reuniendo a más de 3.100 personas unidas por el desafío de transformar el sector. Con el respaldo de inversionistas globales como SoftBank, General Atlantic y Kaszek, hemos levantado más de US$ 755 millones y hoy somos una compañía valuada en US$ 5,1 mil millones .

Lideramos la transformación del mercado siendo pioneros en la aplicación de Inteligencia Artificial a gran escala en el sector inmobiliario. Nuestras plataformas suman más de 50 millones de visitas al mes, administrando más de 350 mil contratos de alquiler activos y movilizando R$ 20 mil millones al año.

Si buscas resolver problemas complejos con autonomía, tecnología de punta e impacto a gran escala, adelante, estás en tu casa.

Para conocer más sobre nuestra historia, ingresa a: grupoquintoandar.com/es/

Ubicación y Modelo de Trabajo

Nuestro equipo comercial trabaja bajo el modelo híbrido, combinando la flexibilidad del trabajo remoto con el intercambio presencial en nuestra oficina de Ciudad de México, 3 veces por semana.

Sobre el Equipo y el Desafío

El equipo de Retención es responsable de reducir la tasa de deserción y maximizar el valor de vida del cliente enfocado exclusivamente en el portafolio de pequeñas y medianas empresas . Esta es una posición de alto impacto y de nueva creación en México; serás responsable de frenar la principal fuga de revenue de la operación, construyendo los cimientos de la retención a nivel local. Buscamos personas con fuertes habilidades de negociación, empatía y resiliencia para liderar a un equipo de 5 personas.

Tus Responsabilidades

• Dirigir, motivar y capacitar a un equipo de retención de 5 personas con perfil junior (mayormente nivel banda 2), brindando un acompañamiento cercano (micromanagement y coaching) para desarrollar sus habilidades de negociación desde cero .

•
Ejecutar estrategias de retención alineando los descuentos previos a la nueva lista de precios, utilizando palancas estratégicas para contener las bajas minimizando el impacto en el ARPA .

•
Gestionar operativamente el flujo de casos de clientes que solicitan darse de baja, los cuales son escalados a través de Salesforce Chatter por los equipos de SMB, Cobranzas y Atención al Cliente .

•
Monitorear métricas clave de éxito basadas en la cantidad de revenue (importe monetario) retenido y facturado, además del Churn Rate y el Customer Health Score .

•
Conducir y supervisar llamadas consultivas de retención (con una duración promedio de 40 minutos), presentando a los clientes dashboards de productividad y métricas de rendimiento para justificar su inversión .

Lo que buscamos (Requisitos)

•
Excelentes competencias de Negociación Avanzada para manejar conversaciones difíciles, apoyándose en el playbook de causísticas para cerrar acuerdos rentables .

•
Sólido dominio de plataformas CRM, preferentemente Salesforce, para la gestión de casos operativos y análisis de datos .

•
Resiliencia para mantener un trato profesional bajo presión y una alta capacidad de empatía para conectar con el cliente de forma genuina .

• Experiencia previa liderando equipos de customer care orientadas a la contención .

title: Strategic Account Manager, Women's Health Sales
description:

This role involves internal collaboration, leading without authority, and forming relationships with key senior level influencers within health systems. 

The SAM (Strategic Account Manager) will cover the PNW region, including WA, OR, ID, MT, and WY. Ideal candidate must reside close to a major airport and be willing to travel within the assigned territory.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Educate and recruit Strategic Accounts and Lab Partners to utilize Natera’s women’s health portfolio of tests.

• Become a subject matter expert in Natera’s technology and service offerings, effectively representing the company to key stakeholders including KOL physicians, Medical Directors, Hospital Administrators, Lab Directors, and Senior Management of Partner Labs.

• Develop relationships within OBGYN residency and MFM fellowship programs through various educational opportunities.

• Collaborate with both internal and external stakeholders in order to implement EMR and UX tools that will drive growth of Natera’s women’s health products.

• Develop and implement business plans that align with sales goals and resource availability, coordinating regional strategies and tactics with Regional Directors.

• Collaborate with the Natera Clinical Field Specialist (CFS) team to maximize business opportunities and partnerships.

• Formulate and execute strategies based on field input, market assessments, and industry trends, consistently applying "Best Practices".

• Work with internal and external key stakeholders to ensure blood access for Natera’s portfolio of tests.

• Establish and maintain positive working relationships with all key customer segments, both internal and external.

• Maintain current status on all Natera training requirements.

• Required travel: 50-75%

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent; MBA preferred.

• Minimum of 3 years of physician sales experience in the diagnostic laboratory industry, preferably within a genetics laboratory.

• At least 3 years of successful sales management or consulting experience in the diagnostic laboratory field.

• Demonstrated success in developing new markets, launching new products, and rapidly increasing revenue.

• Award-winning management or consulting track record.

• Market knowledge and experience in reproductive health is preferred.

• Strong time management skills.

• Effective coaching skills and openness to receiving coaching.

• Team-oriented with excellent initiative and self-motivation.

• Ability to navigate complex situations, both internally and externally.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

• Proven leadership with the ability to think strategically and execute tactically.

• Sense of urgency and focus on driving exceptional revenue growth.

• Capability to develop and execute strategic business plans.

• Confidence in achieving record-breaking growth.

• Expertise in creating and implementing successful sales strategies.

• Strong desire to play a critical role in the organization’s success.

In addition to the OTE listed below, this position will also receive car allowance and restricted-stock units.
The compensation package listed is for 1st year OTE, which are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. On-target earnings (OTE) represent the total potential income an employee can earn by achieving 100% of their performance goals. description:
ABOUT DUALENTRY

DualEntry is building the OS for finance.

 

Every business needs a financial system of record, yet the world's largest fintech market ($220B+) still runs on software from the 1990s, with no new entrants in 30 years. DualEntry's AI-native ERP automates accounting from data entry to close, so finance teams move faster, spend less and incur less risk.

 

In just 2 years we've raised $100M+ from Lightspeed, Khosla Ventures, Contrary and Google Ventures and earned the trust of customers from $5M ARR to publicly traded companies.

 

We hire outliers. We're looking for people with a track record of accomplishing difficult things, whether through their careers or achievements outside of work. You'll find leaders, colleagues who've competed at the highest levels of sport, performed on Broadway, trained with UFC champions and founded the country’s largest Python community - because that's what it takes to reinvent a $220B industry.

📍 Location: New York City HQ, 7 World Trade Center

- Write sharp briefs and hooks from customer insight, then work with designers and editors to ship them fast

- Run a steady test-and-learn loop: launch variants, read the data, stop what doesn't work and scale what does

- Help build our in-house content studio: series, short-form video and ongoing content on CFO and accounting topics

- Use AI tools to cut production from weeks to days, without lowering the bar on taste

- Work closely with Growth, Product Marketing and the founders so creative ties directly to pipeline

 

WHAT SETS YOU UP FOR SUCCESS

- You've got 3-6 years in creative strategy, performance creative or content, ideally at B2B SaaS or fintech

- You write well and have a clear point of view on what makes a good ad

- You're comfortable with data and treat metrics as creative feedback

- You're happy working without a playbook

- Bonus: you can make finance interesting

 

WHY YOU’LL THRIVE HERE

- Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

- You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

- Your feedback shapes the product directly

- High-speed, high-trust environment with high expectations

- Bruno built Slack bots that surface CFO job changes and funding announcements in real time, automate our gifting flow, and sync everything to HubSpot and Hex, so signals become warm intros and campaign performance lands directly in our dashboards.

 

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

title: Supervisor de Vendas (PI)
description:
O Supervisor de Vendas é responsável por coordenar e monitorar o desempenho comercial de uma ou mais linhas de produtos específicas da Anton Paar, garantindo o alcance das metas de vendas, a saúde do *pipeline*, o acompanhamento estratégico de oportunidades e o suporte direto à equipe de vendas.
Atua como elo entre a equipe de vendas, clientes, áreas internas e a matriz, contribuindo para decisões estratégicas, negociações relevantes, monitoramento de KPIs, previsão de vendas e o desenvolvimento de ações necessárias para o crescimento sustentável da linha de produtos sob sua responsabilidade.
Principais Responsabilidades e Atividades
Gestão da linha de produtos sob sua responsabilidade

• Monitorar o desempenho comercial mensal da linha, acompanhando resultados de vendas, projeções de receita, oportunidades em aberto e o progresso em relação à meta anual.

• Analisar a saúde do *pipeline* da linha sob sua responsabilidade, avaliando o volume de oportunidades, o estágio no funil de vendas, a probabilidade de sucesso, os prazos previstos de fechamento e os riscos relacionados ao alcance das metas.

• Realizar acompanhamentos individuais mensais com os vendedores responsáveis ​​pelas oportunidades da linha, revisando KPIs, status de negociação, qualidade do funil, prioridades comerciais e próximos passos.

• Apoiar a definição de estratégias comerciais para garantir o alcance das metas da linha, considerando o mercado, clientes estratégicos, carteira ativa, oportunidades em andamento e ações necessárias para o desenvolvimento de novos negócios.

Monitoramento de vendas, previsão (*forecast*) e KPIs

• Monitorar os números mensais de vendas da linha, bem como a projeção de vendas até o final do ano, antecipando possíveis desvios e propondo ações corretivas.

• Monitorar indicadores de vendas, como oportunidades em aberto, progresso no funil de vendas, probabilidade de fechamento, volume de propostas, descontos aplicados, previsão de vendas (*forecast*), conversão de oportunidades e aderência às metas.

• Garantir que as informações relacionadas às oportunidades estejam atualizadas no CRM, permitindo análises confiáveis ​​do *pipeline*, da previsão de vendas e do desempenho da linha.

• Avaliar oportunidades estratégicas com a equipe de vendas, apoiando a priorização de clientes, negociações e ações comerciais de maior impacto.

Suporte à equipe de vendas

• Fornecer suporte direto à equipe de vendas em negociações relevantes, visitas estratégicas, definição da abordagem comercial e acompanhamento de oportunidades críticas.

• Participar de visitas a clientes com os vendedores quando necessário, especialmente em oportunidades estratégicas, negociações complexas ou contas de maior relevância para a linha. Apoiar a equipe de vendas na análise e concessão de descontos, considerando a estratégia de vendas, a relevância da oportunidade, a competitividade, o relacionamento com o cliente e o impacto nos resultados da linha de produtos.

• Orientar a equipe de vendas quanto às prioridades da linha, auxiliando na tomada de decisão sobre quais oportunidades devem receber maior foco e acompanhamento.

• Dar suporte a processos comerciais específicos, incluindo licitações, solicitações de importação e alinhamentos técnicos e comerciais, sempre que relacionados às linhas de produtos sob sua responsabilidade.

Relacionamento com clientes, áreas internas e matriz

• Manter bom relacionamento com clientes estratégicos, atuando como suporte à equipe de vendas em negociações, visitas e discussões comerciais ou técnicas, quando necessário.

• Atuar em conjunto com áreas internas envolvidas no processo comercial, como logística, importação, financeiro, serviços, aplicações, marketing e outras áreas de suporte.

• Comunicar-se com a equipe da matriz quando necessário, incluindo solicitações de suporte técnico, alinhamento de estratégias globais, acompanhamento de importações, priorização de demandas ou apresentação dos resultados da linha de produtos n

title: Senior Product Manager - Cards
description:

About the team

OpenAI is building a new generation of AI-powered consumer devices, creating opportunities to bring increasingly capable AI into people's everyday lives.

Our Data Engineering team is responsible for establishing the foundational data infrastructure that supports the development, manufacturing, launch, and ongoing operation of these products. As a Data Engineer, you'll design, build, and scale the data infrastructure that powers OpenAI's hardware and consumer devices organization.

You'll tackle technically challenging problems involving complex data sources, evolving operational requirements, and systems that need to scale from early development through manufacturing and consumer deployment.

Unlike roles focused primarily on supporting individual analytics projects, this position emphasizes building durable, reusable data foundations that enable multiple teams and use cases.

- Partner across disciplines: Work with hardware and software engineers, manufacturing teams, operations leaders, and Data Scientists to translate emerging requirements into robust technical solutions.

- Shape our technical direction: Help establish engineering standards, architectural principles, data quality practices, and infrastructure decisions that will influence the organization for years to come.

- Are comfortable making architectural decisions as requirements evolve and the right solutions aren't immediately obvious.

- Are highly self-directed and can take broad, ambiguous problems from exploration through implementation.

- Enjoy working directly with cross-functional partners and understanding how technical decisions affect real products and operational outcomes.

- Have a builder's mentality and are energized by creating foundational systems rather than exclusively optimizing mature infrastructure.

- Hold a high bar for engineering quality while remaining pragmatic about the speed and flexibility required in an early-stage environment.

title: Database Administrator III

Want to be part of a team that keeps AccuWeather 's critical database environments reliable, secure, performant, and available around the clock for a global audience? We are looking for an experienced Database Administrator with deep hands-on expertise in SQL Server and PostgreSQL who can take ownership of the health and reliability of our production database systems while helping modernize our database infrastructure for the future. Reporting directly to the Data Architect II overseeing AccuWeather ’s data architecture function, this role will serve as a hands-on database administration expert responsible for the day-to-day operational health and long-term reliability of AccuWeather 's database environments. Key responsibilities include performance tuning and optimization, backup and recovery, high availability, security and access management, capacity planning, monitoring and maintenance, and incident and root-cause analysis. The DBA will work closely with the Data Architect and engineering teams to establish strong database standards, improve operational practices, and proactively address reliability and performance concerns. This role will also play an important part in the migration of select backend databases to cloud-based environments, helping assess existing workloads, plan and execute migrations, optimize databases for their target environments, and ensure appropriate performance, security, resiliency, and recoverability throughout the transition. It is an opportunity to combine deep database administration expertise with meaningful involvement in the continued modernization of AccuWeather 's data infrastructure.

We are open to hiring candidates to work from our global headquarters in State College, PA, USA, or remotely.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Administer SQL Server and PostgreSQL databases end to end - performance tuning, query optimization, indexing strategy, and execution plan analysis.

• Design, implement, and regularly test backup, replication, and disaster recovery procedures for databases, ensuring high availability across production environments.

• Manage database security - roles, permissions, access control, and auditing.

• Monitor and plan for database capacity - storage growth, connection pooling, and resource allocation.

• Manage database version upgrades, patching cycles, and configuration tuning.

• Perform routine database maintenance - index/statistics upkeep, vacuuming, storage optimization, and space reclamation - to sustain performance over time.

• Proactively monitor database health and performance, identifying and resolving issues before they affect production.

• Manage cloud cost optimization and capacity planning, including license reporting and true-ups, resource forecasting, and optimization of Azure compute spend through Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, and related strategies.

• Partner with the Data Architect and engineering teams to establish database standards, improve operational practices, and proactively address reliability and performance concerns.

• Plan and execute database migrations to the cloud, optimizing configurations for target environments, and ensuring performance, security, resiliency, and recoverability throughout the transition.

• Build strong working relationships with engineering teams, communicating database constraints and recommendations in terms they can act on.

• Share database expertise and best practices with less experienced administrators and engineering team members.

· Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

title: Staff Python Engineer (Contract)
description:
Staff Python Engineer

Independent Contractor Engagement | Remote - Eastern Europe | Data Engineering

This is an independent contractor engagement. This is not an offer of employment.

CONTRACTOR ENGAGEMENT NOTICE: This opportunity is structured as an independent contractor (B2B) engagement. The selected contractor will be responsible for all applicable taxes, social contributions, and statutory obligations in their country of residence. No employment relationship, employee benefits, equity awards, paid leave, or statutory employment protections are created by this engagement. Contractors must hold or obtain the legal right to provide services as an independent contractor in their jurisdiction.

About the Role

Arch Systems is building the future of manufacturing intelligence. Our ArchFX Cloud platform processes millions of IoT data points daily from advanced factory machines worldwide, helping leading manufacturers optimize efficiency, sustainability, and growth.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our data engineering pod as an independent contractor. You'll work with data collected from factory machines and devices - processing, transforming, and preparing it for analytics and visualization. You'll manage and optimize the data pipelines that feed our analytics platform, collaborating closely with our cloud and data science teams to deliver robust, scalable data solutions.

Scope of Engagement

As an independent contractor, you will provide the following services:

• Design and deliver backend features in Python for large-scale enterprise SaaS.

• Contribute to technical excellence through testing, CI/CD, and secure design.

• Provide technical guidance and architectural input across backend initiatives.

• Design data models and pipelines that turn high-volume sensor data streams into clean, structured time-series events, handling late-arriving data, retention windows, and reclassification when downstream rules change.

• Own a sync and reconciliation engine that keeps thousands of distributed edge clients consistent with the cloud, incremental updates on demand, retroactive resync to correct historical state, and atomic merging of concurrent edits without data loss.

• Build integrations between our platform and customer enterprise systems; keep two systems of record consistent under partial failures, late data, and ambiguous record matching.

• Design for correctness under concurrency, interval-based data, transactional guarantees across long-running workflows, and consistency between async workers, polling clients, and human edits.

• Build a configuration system that lets large enterprise customers tailor behaviour without forking the codebase, formula-driven configuration evaluated against a runtime context, with safe extension points for customer-specific logic.

• Build APIs reliable and fast enough to power latency-sensitive operational UIs, endpoints hit every few seconds, where a slow or wrong response is immediately visible to a paying customer.

What You Bring

• 10+ years of professional software development (Python and Django required).

• Experience with large, complex backend SaaS applications.

• Strong skills in modelling complex data systems and delivering scalable solutions.

• Hands-on experience supporting production code and iterating with customer feedback.

• Celery, RabbitMQ, TimescaleDB/Athena, manufacturing/industrial tech background is a plus.

About the Stack

ArchFX Cloud is primarily a Django API server deployed on AWS using Kubernetes, with a PostgreSQL database for all metadata and Athena over S3 for machine data. High-volume machine data is served via a dedicated TimescaleDB time series database and merged with low-volume metadata inside the Django APIs. Customer-facing UIs are implemented as a single-page web app in TypeScript/ Angular. All backend code is written in Python. Background workers run via Celery on RabbitMQ. title: Field Safety Engineer, Germany
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver-The World's Most Experienced Driver™-to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The Waymo Safety team works to promote and help to continuously improve the safety of Waymo’s fully autonomous driving technology. Our experts develop safety goals and strategies, and conduct safety engineering analyses to ensure safety is being considered throughout the design and development of our vehicles. The team develops and promotes safety strategies and policies for autonomous vehicles for its work with regulatory authorities, lawmakers, law enforcement and public and non-profit organizations. Our Safety Team also helps advise on compliance with applicable environmental, health, and safety regulations.

As Waymo’s first Field Safety Engineer in Germany, you will serve as Waymo’s primary engineering/technical liaison with safety regulators in Germany, working closely with Waymo’s Policy, Legal, and other teams in Germany. You will also work with Waymo’s Field Safety team in the United States to identify and analyze issues that could impact the safety of Waymo’s fleet of autonomous vehicles, with a focus on issues specific to Waymo’s operations in Germany. 

This role is based in Munich, reporting to Waymo’s Head of Field Safety, Europe based in California. 

You will:

• You will serve as Waymo’s primary liaison on post-deployment safety with automotive and traffic safety regulators in Germany. You will work with Waymo’s Policy, Legal, and other teams to establish and maintain proactive outreach and respond to regulatory requests.

• You will work with Waymo’s Field Safety team in the United States to identify and analyze issues that could impact the safety of Waymo’s fleet of autonomous vehicles, bringing your local Germany perspective to help identify and prioritize issues that could impact Waymo’s operations in Germany.

• You will act as the lead for Field Safety issues impacting Waymo's operations in Germany.

• You have willingness and ability to participate in regular shifts as part of a 24/7 Safety on-call rotation, which is an integral part of Waymo’s incident response capabilities.

 

You have:

• Bachelor of Science in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical degree.

• 10+ years of engineering or other technical experience in automotive or another transportation field.

• Experience with Germany’s automotive and/or transportation regulatory framework and familiarity with expectations when working with these regulators.

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively with Policy, Legal, Operations, Engineering and other internal teams in UK, Europe and in the United States.

• Strong communication and presentation skills and the ability to establish and maintain professional presence with regulators in Germany.

• Ability to work occasionally in the evenings to collaborate with the US-based Field Safety team.

 

We prefer:

• M.S. or Ph.D. in engineering or a related technical field.

• Experience interacting with automotive and traffic safety regulators.

• Familiarity with autonomous vehicle technology.

• Experience working in a fast-paced, rapidly-scaling company.

• Familiarity with SMS, Safety Case and/or UNECE Automated Driving System regulations.
